data.explanation: The Rentenversicherung (statutory pension insurance) turned down your request for a stay at a rehabilitation clinic, saying the outpatient physiotherapy your orthopedist already prescribed is enough and your ability to work is not seriously at risk. You may object (Widerspruch) in writing, or have it recorded in person, at the address shown; the app will show the exact deadline based on when the letter counts as delivered. If you don't object in time, the rejection becomes final, but you can file a new application anytime your symptoms get worse. Consider getting advice from a patient advocacy service (Sozialverband) if you disagree with the medical assessment.

items.title: File an objection (Widerspruch) against the rejection
items.action: Decide whether to object in writing or have it recorded in person at the Rentenversicherung's office, if you disagree with the rejection.
items.consequence: If you don't object within the deadline, the rejection becomes final.

data.summary: The Rentenversicherung Musterhessen-Lahn (statutory pension insurance, Rehabilitation department) rejected Johanna Beispielacker's application for a stationary medical rehabilitation, judging that her ability to work is not seriously endangered and that the outpatient physiotherapy already prescribed is sufficient. She may file an objection (Widerspruch) within one month of notification.
